checks: Web creates an immutable unbranded GEO configuration through the actual form with fixed questions and no measured aliases injected into prompts
An actual pinned Codex task runs through the synthetic company gateway, captures original bytes and opens the retained answer with its provenance
Two independent real Codex runs retain the same configuration hash and the actual comparison download contains both original answers with matching SHA-256
Changing region through the UI creates configuration version two while the first version and its repeat observations remain unchanged
The consumer sample requires an unchecked user attestation, preserves exact pasted text and unknown model/retrieval metadata, and creates no AI task or zero-cost model claim
The actual UI and comparison response separate consumer/manual surface and configuration changes from API repeat variation
The 400 px English/light and Traditional Chinese/dark observation layouts fit the viewport and the real download button remains clickable after scrolling below the fixed preferences
The prior 800 by 600 feedback report overlap is reproduced with real content and fixed: the download receives its actual click and produces the retained JSON file
The actual Admin content list displays GEO configuration/run/sample kinds inside the reviewer project scope
Independent current Admin body permission opens the retained manual-observation configuration without turning it into an API sample
An actual Admin quarantine blocks the user's existing observation export through the current source checks and records the moderation action
The real Chrome toolbar opens a right native SIDE_PANEL with no popup; real OTP/PKCE sign-in renders bilingual GEO navigation and opens the fixed company cloud workspace
The native Side Panel survives active-page navigation and both language layouts fit its actual width; the owned GEO workspace tab is closed
